plainTranslation: With Composite Uranus in the 12th house, issues from the past can suddenly and unexpectedly become problems within the relationship. You can have sudden insights into subconscious issues, but you can also suddenly undo the relationship because of them. Try taking an unconventional approach to the relationship issues that come about. Sudden and unexpected endings may be normal in this partnership.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
